description: Java source code for a REST API resource managing loan collaterals in the Fineract platform, including endpoints for retrieving templates, listing, retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting collateral data.

classes.name: CollateralsApiResource
classes.description: REST API resource class for managing loan collateral operations in Fineract.

methods.name: newCollateralTemplate
methods.description: Retrieves a template for creating new collateral, including default values and allowed types.

methods.name: retrieveCollateralDetails
methods.description: Lists collaterals for a specific loan.

methods.name: retrieveCollateralDetails
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific collateral by ID, with optional template data.

methods.name: createCollateral
methods.description: Creates a new collateral for a loan.

methods.name: updateCollateral
methods.description: Updates an existing collateral for a loan.

methods.name: deleteCollateral
methods.description: Deletes a collateral from a loan.
